route_title: 28-Layer Parametric Quadratic Chirp with Bounded Optimization
compilation_rationale: Compiler honors topology override to instantiate exactly 12 alternating HfO2/SiO2 layers. Thickness bounds expanded to [20, 250] nm to satisfy the chirp-derived clipping constraint. Dual-band objectives explicitly maximize reflectance (300–450 nm) and transmittance (1000–1700 nm) at normal incidence. Coherent smatrix solver applies standard TMM formalism.
